description: Deterministic business and data integrity validation rules for Loan Performance Intelligence Engine

rules.name: Positive Original Balance
rules.description: Original loan balance must be positive and within reasonable institutional lending limits ($0 - $200k).

rules.name: Valid Current Balance
rules.description: Current balance must be non-negative and cannot exceed the original principal balance (allowing up to 5% capitalized fees).

rules.name: Valid Interest Rate
rules.description: Annualized interest rate must fall within 1.0% and 40.0%.

rules.name: Standard Credit Score Range
rules.description: FICO credit score must be within standard US bureau bounds (300 to 850).

rules.name: Reasonable DTI Ratio
rules.description: Back-end Debt-to-Income ratio must be between 0.0% and 100.0%.

rules.name: Positive Annual Income
rules.description: Borrower self-reported annual income must be greater than $1,000.

rules.name: Valid Loan Term
rules.description: Loan term must match standard contractual amortizations.

rules.name: Non-Negative Days Past Due
rules.description: Days past due counter cannot be negative or absurdly high without write-off.

rules.name: Temporal Monotonicity & Reporting Month
rules.description: Reporting month must be equal to or chronologically after the origination month.

rules.name: Terminal State Invariance
rules.description: Terminal states (DEFAULT, PREPAID, CLOSED) cannot transition back into active performing or delinquent states.

rules.name: Document Verification Completeness
rules.description: Document verification status must match sanctioned audit categories.

rules.name: Valid US State Code
rules.description: Geographic location must be a valid 2-letter postal abbreviation.
